# We're excited to announce v0.2.0!

## Release Highlights

This release marks a major milestone in our journey, showcasing a significant
overhaul of the core experience.

## Key Features

- **New Setting Switch:** Toggle blocking on and off with a seamless, intuitive control
- **Custom Domains:** Block any tracker you want with lightning-fast performance
- **Smart Lists:** Auto-updating filters for ultimate peace of mind

## Improvements

- Enhanced overall performance and stability
- Comprehensive UI/UX refinements
- Streamlined configuration experience

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed several issues
- Resolved edge cases
- Improved reliability

A huge thank you to our amazing community of users and contributors! We can't
wait for you to try it out. 🎉
